FUS-P-05-A2-BSS Stainless Steel Square Passage Knob Set

text.description_html:
Fusion P-05-A2-BSS Stainless Steel Square Passage Knob Set

A modern styled satin stainless steel passage door knob set from Fusion Hardware. The square shape allows for this modern material knob and rose set to look great in all contemporary decors. It will fit 1-1/4 inch to 2 inch thick doors and has a backset of 2-3/8 inches. Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Finished in Satin Stainless Steel.

Features of the Fusion Stainless Steel Square Passage Knob Set:

  • Solid Stainless Steel Construction
  • Cycle Tested to ANSI Standards
  • Exclusive Fusion knob spring assembly for lifetime performance
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish
  • Easy assembly with alignment block and rose posts

Specifications for Fusion Stainless Steel Square Passage Knob Set:

  • Knob: 2" Square
  • Knob projection: 1-7/8"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-7/8"
  • Rose Projection: 3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4" to 2"
  • Backsets: 2-3/8"
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Square corner latches and strike plates
  • Function: Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only (1) Left.
